name: HOME_APPROVALS_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: HOME_APPROVALS_20261103 — Home v008 "Needs you": the request store, the closed 7-type action list,
server-only decide() (sealed OperatorContext, tailnet listener, actor binding), click-time revalidation,
immutable approval binding, exclusive per-request execution markers, timeout/partial attempted receipts,
the nudge event stream, and read-only fact adapters. Hermetic: tmp state root, fake runners, fake /proc tree.
The cx-openai-3 whole-head grounds at a9ffe5be5 are pinned here: canonical approver identity (case and
the tailnet: prefix), per-record validation before any projection filters (a corrupt record is store_unreadable,
never an empty board), marker settlement when revalidation raises before the action starts, question() as a
locked transition re-read, request-id validation before any lock path, and a re-run ledger that refuses
malformed counters instead of reading them as zero.
